newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish car association ups sales forecast.
newsitem.headline: Swedish car association ups sales forecast.

text.p: The association of Swedish Automobile Manufacturers and Wholesalers, an industry group, said on Friday it upgraded its forecast for new Swedish car sales in 1997 to 215,000 from 200,000.

"This would be the highest annual level in the 1990s, but it would still be well below the annual average in the 1980s, which was 255,000 cars," Kurt Palmgren, head of the association, said in a statement.
The scrapped special tax on new cars and new rules for company cars have led to increased demand for new cars, the association said.
"The low interest rate level and the increased optimism about the economic development has contributed to households choosing to buy new cars," it said.
